LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_AutoModeButtonDesc: Choose how this pawn automatically distributes stat points. The button works whether auto allocation is currently enabled or disabled.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_AutoModeBalancedDesc: New automatic points are added evenly across STR, DEX, VIT, INT, WIS and CHA. Existing final stats are not equalized.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_AutoModeClassDesc: Primary class stat receives 3 shares, secondary 2 shares and every other stat 1 share. Berserker combines both affinities into 4 Strength shares.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_AutoModeRequiresClass: Class-weighted allocation becomes available after a class is assigned. Use Balanced until then.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_PetAutoToggleDesc: Automatically spend this creature's new stat points. Enabled by default for player creatures.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_PetAutoModeButtonDesc: Choose how this creature distributes newly earned stat points. Its innate rank-generated stats are left intact.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_PetAutoModePhysicalDesc: STR, DEX and VIT receive 2 shares each; INT, WIS and CHA receive 1 share each. This is the default.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_PetAutoModeBalancedDesc: New points are divided equally among all six stats.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_PetAutoModeChanged: {0}: creature automatic stat distribution is now {1}.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsIntro: These options apply immediately. Global switches pause features without deleting per-colonist or per-pet choices stored in the save.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsEnablePawnAutoDesc: When enabled, the add-on replaces ISEKAI's automatic allocation with the selected fair mode. When disabled, ISEKAI's original algorithm and checkbox remain active. Saved mode choices are preserved.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsPawnDefaultModeDesc: Used only when a colonist has no saved personal mode. Class-weighted defaults remain Balanced until that colonist receives a class.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsEnablePetAuto: Enable automatic stat allocation for ISEKAI pets
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsEnablePetAutoDesc: Master switch for pet allocation and its controls. Turning it off pauses the feature without deleting saved pet settings or unspent points.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsPetEnabledDefault: Enable auto allocation for new or unconfigured pets
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsPetEnabledDefaultDes: Initial per-pet switch value. Existing pets that already have a saved choice are not changed.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsPetDefaultMode: Default mode for new or unconfigured pets
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsPetDefaultModeDesc: Initial per-pet mode. Existing pets that already have a saved mode are not changed.
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsShowModeMessages: Show a message when an allocation mode is changed
LanguageData.IsekaiFixes_SettingsShowModeMessagesDesc: Controls only the confirmation message produced after manually changing a colonist or pet mode.
